text:
I am yours, God knows why, since I understand

that you will abandon me, coldly, tomorrow,

and that beneath the charm of my eyes, desire

is won by another charm, but I do not defend myself.


I wait for this to end on any given day,

for I intuit, instantly, what you think or want.

With indifferent voice I speak to you of other women

and even rehearse the praise of one who was yours.


But you know less than I, and somewhat proud

that I belong to you, in your deceptive game

you persist, with the air of an actor owning the role.


I look at you silently with my sweet smile,

and when you grow enthusiastic, I think: do not hurry.

It is not you who deceives me; what deceives me is my dream.

translation.title: The Deception
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the speaker's lucid awareness that the real deception is self-made.
